text: Coffee with Nasser. He starts at the new firm on November 3rd, team lead role, bit daunted by it. His wife Dana has taken up pottery and apparently the garage is now a studio. Text him Monday night to wish him luck.
Callum's retiring after 31 years at the depot, last day is Friday the 14th. Leaving do at the Crown that evening. His daughter Caitlin is flying back from Toronto for it, which he doesn't know yet.

Long call with Hoang. Still obsessed with Warhammer, painting a whole Ultramarines army over winter. His brother is getting married in Hanoi on Dec 6 and the whole family is going for two weeks. He sounded tired, the new job's been brutal so far. His girlfriend Neha is going too, first time meeting his grandparents. Must ask him for photos when he's back.
Karim got the promotion! Senior engineer from Jan 2. He and Noor are celebrating with dinner at that Lebanese place Saturday. Need to send a congrats card before then.

Eamon was quieter than usual. His mum's going in for a hip replacement next Tuesday and he's driving up to Leeds to look after her. I should ring him Wednesday to see how it went. He's also been made acting manager while his boss is off, so the timing's awful. Said he's barely sleeping.
Abebe and his partner Tanvi both run with the Harriers. Half marathon on March 22nd, she's chasing a sub 1:45. He's more into the cycling now anyway.

Catch up with Seo-yeon over lunch. She's leaving the agency end of this month, going freelance. Her son Ali started reception in September and loves it. She mentioned she's been wanting a proper drawing tablet, the big Wacom one. Possible leaving present?
Nora's knitting a blanket for her sister's baby, due 12/2. Pale yellow, moss stitch. Sister is Simone, I met her at the barbecue.
Sean cancelled the Lisbon trip, work wouldn't sign off the leave. Gutted. Taking a long weekend in Cornwall instead, Oct 31 to Nov 3.
Florin's dog Bruno had his operation yesterday, knee ligaments. Went fine but he's on crate rest for six weeks. Florin's working from home to keep an eye on him. Check in on Friday.
Adaeze first day at the hospital trust tomorrow! Pharmacy, band 7. Text her good luck tonight.

Dinner at Ali and Petra's. They're finally doing the extension, builders start May 4. Their eldest Isaac is doing GCSEs next summer and is very into chess, plays for the county under 16s. Petra's dad turns 80 on the 19th, they're hosting a party for him the Saturday after. I'm bringing the cake.
Nina's new manager is a nightmare apparently. She's thinking of leaving but wants to wait for her review on June 10. Don't forget to ask how it went.
Siddharth, Sid to everyone at the club, has been made captain of the second XI. First match of the season is April 18th. He's a massive Spurs fan too so avoid the subject after Sunday.

Elijah's moving to Bristol for the new job, starts Monday the 9th. His girlfriend Vanessa is staying put until her lease ends in spring. He's nervous about making friends there. Must send him my cousin's number. Leaving drinks are this Friday at the Lamb, I'm going.

Moira retires next Friday. Forty years teaching. Her husband Florin is planning a surprise lunch and asked me to come, said yes. She's going to spend the time on her allotment and finally learn the cello.
Bought stamps, posted the forms. Dentist moved to Thursday 3pm.
Neha says the band are playing the Fleece on Nov 21. She's on bass now, the old bassist quit. Her brother Sean does the sound. Get tickets this week before they go.

Caitlin's mum has been in and out of hospital, heart stuff. Caitlin's exhausted, juggling that and the kids. Her husband's away on a rig until the 28th. Should drop round with dinner this weekend. Her eldest, Nora, has her grade 5 violin exam on the 4th too and Caitlin can't even get her to practise. Poor woman.
Talked to Tanvi about the book club. She's reading the whole Wolf Hall trilogy for it, halfway through the second one. Hates audiobooks, says she can't concentrate.
Noor and Karim's anniversary is 7/8, ten years. Noor hinted that Karim would love tickets to see Arsenal at the Emirates. Remind me to ask Zara if she can sort something with her season ticket.
Zofia Nowak has been offered the deputy head job at St Anne's. Starts after Easter. She was worried it'd be too much with her twins but her partner is going part time to help. Huge news.
Hiroshi's back from Osaka. His dad's recovering well from the stroke, walking again. Hiroshi's returning to work on Monday but just mornings to start.
Dana sounded really anxious. Interview at the council on Thursday, second round, presentation and panel. She's been prepping every night. Text her Wed evening.
Zara's leaving drinks were last night. Good send-off. She starts at the BBC on the 2nd, digital desk. Her girlfriend Chioma made a cake shaped like a microphone.
Chioma is mad about crochet now. Amigurumi animals mostly, sells a few on Etsy. She's vegan and hates coriander, worth remembering for the dinner.
Rebecca, Becks, was at the school gate. Her eldest got into the grammar, results came Friday. Her younger one has his grading for karate next Saturday, yellow belt.
Note to self: book the MOT before the 30th, and cancel the gym membership.

Nasser's son Elijah has his driving test on the 23rd. Third attempt, poor kid is a wreck about it. Nasser says don't mention it to him. He's been out practising with his uncle Florin every evening this week and on Saturday too. I should text Nasser on the 24th to see how it went.
Quick one: Callum's grandson was born Sunday! 8lb 2oz and named after Callum. Callum's daughter Caitlin and her husband are doing well. Send flowers.

Karim said his brother Nasser lost his job last week, the whole team was made redundant. Nasser's trying to stay positive but money's tight with the baby. Karim's helping with the CV. I should check if anyone at work is hiring.
Hoang's into vinyl in a big way. Mostly 70s Japanese city pop, Tatsuro Yamashita, Mariya Takeuchi. Hunting for a first pressing of For You. Good to know for Christmas.

Lunch with Eamon and Sean. Eamon's band has a gig on the 15th at the Golden Lion. Sean's wife is expecting their second in May. Sean's also up for promotion, finds out next week. Busy lads. Eamon's taken up running too, doing the Couch to 5k, says his knees hate him.
Abebe's mum is visiting from Addis for a month, lands next Wednesday. He's taking her to see the Lake District and Edinburgh. She's never been to the UK.

Seo-yeon's husband Karim got the job in Seoul, they're moving out there in the summer, probably July. She's excited and terrified. Kids will go to the international school. Sounds like a leaving party in June. Their youngest, Zofia, is gutted about leaving her swim club.
Nora said her dad passed away on Sunday. Funeral is the 28th. Need to send a card and ask if they want anything for the wake.
Simone has started at Deloitte, audit. First week was all induction. She says the commute is killing her, 90 mins each way. Give her a call at the weekend.
Petra plays in a five-a-side league on Tuesdays and supports Sparta Prague. Her husband Ali hates football, which is very funny to her.
Isaac Fernández from next door, his cat Pepper went missing three days ago. He's put posters up everywhere. Keep an eye out on the walk.

Caught up with Florin on the phone. His sister Adaeze, no wait his sister-in-law, is graduating from her nursing degree on June 3rd. He's also thinking about going back to uni himself, part time MSc in data science, applications close Jan 15. His wife Chioma thinks he should go for it. They're off to Romania for Christmas to see his parents, back on the 3rd, so he'll do the application after that.
Ali's dad is retiring from the restaurant next month and handing it to Ali's cousin. Big family dinner for it on Sunday the 16th. Ali's not sure how his dad will cope without it.
Nina and her fiance are getting married next August. Engagement party at her parents' place this Saturday. Need to buy a card and something nice tomorrow.
Siddharth Kumar's daughter starts university in Manchester next week. Medicine. He's dropping her off Sunday, already emotional about it.
Elijah got back to me. Bristol is good, the job's going well, and he's joined a climbing gym. Vanessa visited last weekend. Sounds happier.
Vanessa's sister Nina is doing the Edinburgh fringe in August with her improv group. Vanessa's going up for the opening night on Aug 4.
Moira's grandson Callum has a piano recital on May 14 and is apparently very nervous. Moira asked if I'd come. Said I would.
Neha's partner Hoang started his PhD this month, marine biology in Plymouth. She's staying in Exeter, they'll do weekends. Her mum keeps asking when they'll marry, which Neha finds exhausting.
Did the big shop and sorted the recycling. Need to renew passport before March.

Talked to Caitlin and her husband Eamon at the fair. Eamon's been made redundant, consultation ended Thursday. They're putting the house sale on hold. Caitlin says he's not sleeping. Check in on them next week, and ask Hiroshi if his firm has openings.
Tanvi's brother Siddharth is moving in with her for a few months while he sorts out a new job. He's a sous chef, just left the Savoy. She's not thrilled about the shared bathroom.
Noor said her team's away day is in Brighton on the 11th. She's presenting the new strategy to the board the Monday after, 10/18. Bit nervous. Wish her luck Sunday night.
Zofia is in a choir, they're doing the Messiah at the cathedral on Dec 13. She's alto. Her twins are in the kids' choir too.
Hiroshi Tanaka, my old boss, rang. He's finally retiring, last day is the end of March. Wants a small lunch with the old team, maybe the 27th. I'll organise it.
Dana's girlfriend Rebecca is running the London marathon in April for a cancer charity. Her mum had breast cancer last year. Sponsor her when the page goes up.

Met Zara's new boss Chioma briefly, very friendly. Zara says the BBC job is intense but she loves it. Her mum's coming to stay next weekend and her brother Isaac is starting at Leeds on the 22nd. Lots going on. Zara also mentioned she's been learning Portuguese on Duolingo, 200 day streak.
Rebecca's book club picked Piranesi. Meeting is next Thursday. Haven't started it.

Nasser and Dana are hosting a housewarming on Saturday 5/24, from 4. Dana said they'd love a plant for the new garden. Their kids Elijah and Nora are thrilled with the bigger bedrooms. Ask Callum if he wants a lift. Nasser's starting at the new company the week after, so it's a lot at once.
Callum. Fly fishing. He's done a course and is booking a week in the Highlands in June. His wife Moira thinks he's mad. He wants a new reel for his birthday, the 9th.

Abebe told me his new role at the bank starts on the 1st. Big step up, analytics manager. His old boss Petra Fischer is throwing him leaving drinks next Thursday. Should get something for the collection by Wednesday.
Seo-yeon says her daughter Zara is obsessed with Taylor Swift and has the Eras tour film on loop. Birthday is 6/21, turning 11.
